subtopics.title: Principles of Network Applications
subtopics.summary: Network application architectures (client-server vs. P2P), processes communicating through sockets, transport services available to applications, transport services provided by the Internet (TCP vs. UDP), and what an application-layer protocol defines.

subtopics.title: The Web and HTTP
subtopics.summary: Overview of HTTP, non-persistent vs. persistent connections, HTTP message format, user-server interaction with cookies, web caching, and HTTP/2.

subtopics.title: Electronic Mail in the Internet
subtopics.summary: SMTP for mail transfer, mail message formats (headers and body), and mail access protocols used to retrieve messages.

subtopics.title: DNS: The Internet's Directory Service
subtopics.summary: Services provided by DNS and an overview of how DNS works, including its distributed, hierarchical name-server structure.

subtopics.title: Peer-to-Peer File Distribution
subtopics.summary: How P2P architectures distribute a file among peers and how this scales compared with client-server distribution.

subtopics.title: Video Streaming
subtopics.summary: How streaming applications deliver stored video over the Internet, including the bandwidth and timing considerations unique to streaming media.

subtopics.title: Socket Programming with TCP and UDP
subtopics.summary: The socket interface and development of simple client-server network applications in Python, over both TCP and UDP.
